title: The imagery of the psalms of prophecy soothed his barren pride. The glories of Mary held his soul captive: spikenard and myrrh and frankincense, symbolizing her royal lineage, her emblems, the late-flowering plant and late-blossoming tree, symbolizing the age-long gradual growth of her cultus among men
html_source: Stephen may lose his faith, he may sin freely and he may roll his eyes at people who are desperate to show God their devotion, but he will never get tired of the sensory pleasures of the Church. Just like an artist he is drawn to the sights, smells and sounds that the Church offers

anchor.prefix: im. If at moments he felt an impulse to rise from his post of honour and, confessing before them all his unworthiness, to leave the chapel, a glance at their faces restrained him.
anchor.suffix:
When it fell to him to read the lesson towards the close of the office he read it in a veiled voice, lulling his conscience to its music.

 Quasi cedrus exaltata sum in Libanon et
